subtopics.title: Defining Evaluation Criteria
subtopics.summary: Establishing what an application should and should not do, including out-of-scope inputs and expected responses, to avoid ambiguous scoring.

subtopics.title: Creating Scoring Rubrics
subtopics.summary: Developing unambiguous scoring guidelines and examples, including providing scoring reasons, to ensure consistent evaluation by human or AI judges.

subtopics.title: Selecting Evaluation Methods
subtopics.summary: Choosing appropriate evaluation methods for different criteria, such as toxicity classifiers, semantic similarity, and AI judges for factual consistency.

subtopics.title: Domain-Specific Capability Benchmarks
subtopics.summary: Using public or private benchmarks to evaluate specific capabilities like code generation, math, reasoning, and legal knowledge.

subtopics.title: Generation Capability Metrics
subtopics.summary: Evaluating generation qualities such as fluency, coherence, factual consistency, and safety, many of which evolved from traditional NLP.
